_note: Accepted two-way schema pairs and table cycles (db/tools/schema_dependencies.py). Add an entry only with its reason, in the same change as the schema file that needs it.

schema_pairs.acct<->sales: E-invoices name their source sale; refunds and compensation keep the credit note issued for them
schema_pairs.fin<->iam: Wallets belong to parties and companies; family accounts and API clients keep the wallet or provider they use
schema_pairs.fin<->ops: Settlement lines name the trip; shuttle rides and segment charges keep their wallet and ledger transaction
schema_pairs.fin<->pricing: Price allocations apply pricing schemes; a sponsor account owns a wallet
schema_pairs.fin<->sales: Payments and allocations name the booking; a booking keeps its frozen price allocation; passes keep their wallet
schema_pairs.fin<->ship: Allocations name the shipment; cash-on-delivery, claims and settlements keep their ledger transaction
schema_pairs.fleet<->iam: Vehicles belong to companies; documents point at the vehicle, licence, lease or policy they prove (typed references)
schema_pairs.fleet<->ops: Trips use vehicles; vehicle history, claims and driving hours name the trip or incident
schema_pairs.fleet<->ptn: Fuel cards and sessions name vehicle and driver; a licence record can belong to a partner
schema_pairs.frt<->ship: Freight requests use shipment addresses and legs; a leg runs under a freight contract
schema_pairs.gov<->iam: Governance records name users and companies; personal records keep their retention policy and erasure request
schema_pairs.gov<->sec: A privacy incident names its security event; policy decisions name the data purpose
schema_pairs.iam<->net: Networks belong to companies; station scopes and documents point at stations
schema_pairs.iam<->ops: Operations name companies and users (actors); documents can belong to an incident (typed reference)
schema_pairs.iam<->ref: Parties use reference countries and currencies; files belong to companies and uploaders
schema_pairs.iam<->sec: Encrypted personal columns name their key in the key registry; security records name users; company keys
schema_pairs.ops<->sales: Tickets are for a trip and its stops; seat segments and boarding name the ticket
schema_pairs.ops<->sec: Authority alerts, manifests and SOS name the trip; presence beacons name their key
schema_pairs.pricing<->sales: Sales use fares, campaigns and commission schemes; loyalty points name the booking
schema_pairs.ref<->sec: Files name their encryption key; signatures, alerts and manifests name their file
schema_pairs.sales<->sec: Encrypted passenger data and ticket codes name their key; authority orders and screening name the booking
